WITH counts AS (
  SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM fielding AS f
  JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = f.player_id
  GROUP BY p.bats
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count
  FROM counts
),
ratios AS (
  SELECT c.bats, c.record_count, 1.0 * c.record_count / total.total_count AS ratio
  FROM counts AS c
  CROSS JOIN total
),
average AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM ratios
)
SELECT r.bats, r.record_count, r.ratio, r.record_count - a.avg_count
FROM ratios AS r
CROSS JOIN average AS a
WHERE r.record_count > a.avg_count
